name: one-minute-pr
description: Open a pull request whose body a human reviewer can judge in one minute: fixed sections (Why, What changed, Scope, Tradeoffs, Blast Radius, Rollback, Verification), only evidence the agent has seen, and a bundled script that fails the body on section order, a missing Rollback, long dashes, curly quotes, or mid-sentence colons. Works in Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity.
